quote: @pytest.mark.skip(reason="bounds are checked in the integration suite until the rewrite lands")
title: The only test of the upper discount bound is skipped, and no running test pins 100/101
evidence: The skipped test_discount_bounds is the only test that calls apply_discount(100, 101). The running tests reject only -1 (tests/test_helpers_ok.py:19), 200 (tests/test_helpers_ok.py:34) and 500 (tests/test_helpers_ok.py:68). The workspace holds no integration suite (only src/ and tests/). I copied src/cart.py into my notes and mutated it, then ran each running test's assertion against the copy (notes/mut.py). Changing `percent > 100` to `percent > 101` passes every running assertion. Changing it to `percent >= 100` also passes every one. Under the first mutant apply_discount(100, 101) returns -1.0.
failing_case: Someone changes the guard in src/cart.py:9 to `percent > 101`. All running tests pass. apply_discount(100, 101) then returns -1.0, a negative total, instead of raising ValueError. The `>= 100` mutant, which wrongly rejects a 100% discount, also passes.
remediation: Add running tests for the boundaries: apply_discount(100, 101) raises, apply_discount(100, 100) == 0, and apply_discount(100, 0) == 100. Un-skip test_discount_bounds, or point the skip reason at a real integration test file that exists.

title: Helper named `test` matches pytest's default collection prefix and errors with a missing fixture
evidence: pytest's default python_functions is `test`, a prefix match, so a module-level function named exactly `test` is collected. Its parameter `name` is not a fixture and nothing in the repo defines one (no conftest.py, no config file). pytest was not installed in the sandbox and I may not install it, so I traced this and did not run it.
failing_case: Run `pytest tests/test_helpers_ok.py`. It collects `test` and reports `fixture 'name' not found`, an ERROR. A file meant to hold only correct tests fails every run, and the error hides real regressions in the summary.
remediation: Rename the helper so it does not start with `test` (for example `mark_test`), or move it to a non-test module.
